title: (Deprecated) Create a Quick Optimization task
content_data:
Use this endpoint to create a video optimization task, which is mainly about HORIZONTAL to VERTICAL transformation now. The execution time is approximately 1/2 of video duration. See [Smart Video Soundtrack, Smart Video, and Quick Optimization](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1749022727865345) to find out the brief introduction of the Quick Optimization feature. Generated video name is `_optimize_.mp4`. The rate limits for this endpoint are: ```xtable | Level {20%} | Query Per Second{20%} | Query Per Minute{20%} | Query Per Day{20%} | |---|---|---| | Basic | 1 | 30 | 5000 | | Advanced | 2 | 60 | 10000 | | Premium | 3 | 90 | 15000 | ``` ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/creative/quick_optimization/create/|/v1.3/creative/quick_optimization/create/ | | Request parameter data type | `advertiser_id`: number |`advertiser_id`: string | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/quick_optimization/create/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |--- |--- |--- | |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request content type
Accepted Value: `"application/json"` | |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |-|-|-| | advertiser_id{Required} |string| Advertiser ID | | video_id{Required} | string | Video ID | | logo | string | Logo image ID, which will be shown in the optimized video | | title | string | Title, which will be shown in the optimized video. Limit: 2-20 characters. | | description | string | Description, which will be shown in the optimized video | | callback_info | object | Callback information| #| callback_url{+Conditional} | string | Callback address. Required when you set `callback_info`. | #| callback_extra_info | object | Extra callback information, which will be returned when call back.| ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |-|-|-| |code |number|Return code, see "[Appendix-Return code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097)".| |message |string|Return message, see "[Appendix-Return information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097)".| |data|object|Returned data| #|task_id |string|Task ID | |request_id|string|Request ID| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response python) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "task_id": "1864502164429996038" }, "request_id": "2020082410541601018904922344E10F07" } (/code) ```
